correctness.rationale: The stationary causal process exists uniquely for z>0. Joint Markov generator and symmetric monomial recurrence close exactly to degree four. Symbolic elimination gives a rational positive denominator times -3P. The polynomial is strictly convex in switching rate and strictly increasing with damping on the positive quadrant; its value at zero switching is positive, and it is coercive in switching rate. Its minimum is continuous strictly increasing with damping, negative near zero by explicit factorization and positive at unit damping by convexity. Therefore precisely one damping value has a double positive root, with two roots below and none above. The supplied standalone checker reproduces all-parameter polynomial identities and independently solves four exact rational stationary moment systems. No limiting finite enumeration is used to prove the global result.

value.rationale: Fourth-cumulant sign separates sub-Gaussian from super-Gaussian stationary position statistics in a physically standard colored-noise resonator. The exact topology of its positive-kurtosis window, a unique sharp damping threshold and a reentrant pair of switching-rate roots are natural parameter-global structural facts that a second-moment calculation cannot detect. It refines the known qualitative underdamped/overdamped division by locating a much smaller sharp non-Gaussian threshold; no claim of thermodynamic criticality or new general moment method is made.
